nuggets.text: The Spiders are one of a kind: Richmond is the only US university with the spider as its official nickname.
The Spiders most likely borrowed their name in the 1890s from baseball's Cleveland Spiders.
The Spiders' spider mascot answers to the name WebstUR.
The Spiders' lone win over NC State came in 1970, a surprising 21-6 upset at Richmond's City Stadium.
The Spiders and NC State once played to a 0-0 tie, way back in 1906.
Spiders freshman Bryce Allen became the first Richmond freshman with 100 receiving yards in an opener since 1949.
Spiders lineman Camden Byrd, the preseason Patriot League Defensive Player of the Year, opened 2026 with three sacks.
The Spiders arrive in Raleigh 2-0 after edging Howard 28-21 last week.
The Spiders won the 2008 FCS national title, beating Montana 24-7 in the championship game.
The Spiders' rivalry with William & Mary, dating to 1898, is the fourth most-played in Division I football.
